# HandParts

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/HandParts.cs#L14)

Which hand a collider belongs to, whichever layer of the hand it sits on.

A hand is four sets of colliders: the tracked fingertip triggers that feed the grab test, the
grab hand's own reach sphere, the physics hand's palm, and the finger bodies the physics
fingers build at run time under a root of their own. Each carries its side in a different
place, and anything in the scene that wants to know "is this the right hand touching me" had
to know all four. Now it asks here.
